notes.title: Patch 1.02 is live - simplified tutorial and bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello fair travellers on yonder twisted paths,

we have patch 1.02 for you. Apologies it took us a bit longer than expected.


[list]
[*][b][FIX][/b] - Harlowe's rooms now all have exits. Previously, his second room spawned without any bridges.
[*][b][FIX][/b] - You should no longer randomly change characters while reloading or restarting the game. Let us know if you still encounter this issue!
[*][b][FIX][/b] - Harlowe's Vanguard Skilltree was upside down. Sorry, you'll only be able to unlock that first skill after levelling him up quite a bit.
[*][b][FIX][/b] - The Health tooltip in German was broken. It now works again.
[*][b][FIX][/b] - The [i]Continue[/i] button was greyed out if you returned to the main menu after solving an act. This no longer happens.
[*][b][IMPROVEMENT][/b] - Yara's Act is now considerably shorter and much, much easier - you can still die if you are careless, but you'll find it much easier to unlock Harlowe now.
[/list]

[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]

Sorry everyone, we are still working on getting all achievements ready - the hidden achievements cannot be completed for now. We know, we know, it's painful for fellow completionists like us as well. Bug hunting has reduced our internal roadmap for some quality of life improvements, but we're on them.


Thank you so much for your reports and support. Don't forget to write a review if you enjoyed the game, and even if not, to let other potential players see what it's about!


Much love and happy puzzling,
Manu & Björn from KnotHorn Studio

notes.title: We are Live!
notes.content:
We're proud to announce the full release of [b]Once Upon A Tile[/b]!


So you played the Demo and want to know what to expect?

[list]
[*][b]Three new heroes![/b] - Join Harlowe the grizzled warrior hamster, Under the ratling thief and Hieronymous the trickster ferret in their dangerous journey!
[*][b]A full story modus![/b] - Choose which of the heroes to follow on their journey to certain doom! Each journey will provide you with a new perspective.
[*][b]Skills and unique rooms![/b] - You will be able to upgrade your characters, unlocking unique skills such as Hieronymous' Trickery, which allows you to reshuffle the deck, or Under's Tunnel, which provides a small dungeon tile to get out of tricky situations!
[*][b]Unique Boss mechanics[/b] - Face dangerous new modifications at the end of each Act! Will you find out in time how to solve the deadly puzzles, or will you succumb to the new mechanics?
[*][b]Scaling difficulty![/b] - The further you venture into the dungeons, the more difficult the journey is going to become. You will need to be careful when selecting your loadout and your path through the twisted, cursed lands!
[*][b]A beautiful, semi-generative soundtrack![/b] - Each character comes with their own theme song, which will adapt itself to new locations and new situations!
[/list]

What are you waiting for? The cursed lands needs heroes... or, at the very least, your guidance of them.
